releaseNotes: Category organization polish: Find results now show each file's Smart Life category or Uncategorized, with an Uncategorized quick filter and a clear Already in Category message. Category rename/delete remain Smart Life tag operations only and never delete or move the Android file. Sounds & Effects now uses anchored dropdown/combo controls for Navigation effect and Reminder effect with immediate preview, while Reminder repeats remains a dropdown. The existing v0.10.0 Arabic OCR/search stack is preserved.
